categories_thin: Septic - Edison is largely sewered; searches returned almost only out-of-town firms
Locksmiths - few Edison-address independents; results dominated by national key-duplication chains and call-center style listings
Self storage - dominated by national brands (Public Storage, Extra Space, U-Haul)
Chimney, gutters, fencing, garage doors - many service-area brands with suite or residential addresses rather than real yards
Security installers - several national/regional providers, few clearly local firms
caveats: Google Maps showed a capped result set per query (about 11 listings, then 'limited view'), so each category list is a partial slice, not the full market.
Many entries are service-area operators with suite or residential-style addresses; their physical presence in Edison is unverified and flagged as 'address town unverified'.

National and regional chains/franchises were excluded per brief (e.g. Pep Boys, Mavis, Terminix, SERVPRO, PuroClean, Two Men and a Truck, Stanley Steemer, Public Storage, Extra Space, U-Haul, KeyMe, Floor & Decor, The Tile Shop, Power Home Remodeling, Window World, CertaPro, Five Star Painting, Precision Painting Plus, Paint EZ, Two Maids, Molly Maid, MaidPro, Ace Handyman, 1-800-GOT-JUNK, Junkluggers, College Hunks, Mr. Appliance, Sears, Precision Door, Superior Fence & Rail, Everon).
Some kept entries may be larger regional firms or shared-address marketing operations; notes flag these for triage.
